messages:
Riley (New Engineer): Morning! Two quick payroll/benefits questions before my first all-hands:
1) I submitted my W-4 but mistakenly left a box checked. I need to change it to single with no adjustments. Can I update ADP myself or do I need to file a paper form?
2) I shipped some furniture for my home office on my start week. Is that eligible under moving reimbursement?

Marta (People Ops): Welcome, Riley!
1) ADP self-service should handle W-4 changes. Go to ADP > Myself > Tax Withholding. If you changed after payroll cutoff we'll need to do a retro update.
2) Home office furniture is usually not covered unless specified in the relocation addendum. If you have a signed relocation agreement that lists "temporary home office stipend" then file under that. Otherwise it's not eligible. Upload receipts and the signed agreement if you have it.

Riley (New Engineer): I do have a relocation addendum that mentioned a "home office stipend". It didn't say taxable or not 0 would that normally be taxed?

Omar (Payroll): Stipends are generally taxable unless explicitly called a non-taxable reimburse (rare). We can process it as a stipend through payroll which will include taxes. If you prefer reimbursement (non-payroll) and the agreement allows, People Ops/Finance will route it differently.

Riley (New Engineer): OK I'll upload everything. Also, will my first paycheck show an itemized line for this stipend or just net pay? I ask because I need an itemized proof for a rental agreement.

Omar (Payroll): If processed through payroll, you'll have an earnings line in ADP showing the stipend amount and appropriate taxes withheld; that should be suitable. If it's a reimbursement through expenses, you'll get an expense payment confirmation.

Riley (New Engineer): Perfect. Thanks.

Benefits Bot: Reminder: If you're adding dependents, upload documentation within 30 days of eligibility or enrollment may be denied. Accepted docs: marriage cert, domestic partner affidavit + 2 proofs of shared residence.

Marta (People Ops): One last thing: if you ever need someone to check the paperwork before submission, DM me and I can do a quick pre-check to avoid delays. Congrats again!
